# {{ site.author.name }}

> {{ site.description }}

This is {{ site.author.name }}'s personal site: a short bio, career history, and occasional writing. Sushant founded CiteOnly (https://citeonly.com), an AI that cannot make things up: it generates only citations, word for word from the user's own documents, each with its source beside it, and has no free-generation step.

## Pages

- [Home]({{ site.url }}/): Photo and short bio.
- [Career]({{ site.url }}/career/): Roles, projects, and education, most recent first.
- [Writing]({{ site.url }}/writing/): Notes and posts, filterable by tag.
